word.item: I am called Mary Vwamula Inyanje.
I am in the village of Mahanga in the house of Reverend Pastor Harun Masambu.
I want to explain the way we pluck tea leaves.
You slash your farm you dig and do weeding again and then you measure feet.
Three feet from the other line and from the tea you measure two feet.
Going to the other when you plant tea you plant your tea and then they finish three years.
And then you begin to pluck and when we begin to pluck tea there is a way that you dress because eeh.
We wake up at five o'clock in the morning and when we wake up at five o'clock.
There is a lot of cold or it is raining until you dress we put on a sweater or a jacket.
For the rain and then we dress.
After dressing we tie around this to cover from the mist.
We tie around a nylon that is the cloth that we pluck what tea we put it on.
Because there is a lot of cold.
You cannot manage and we wake up at five o'clock and we cover even the head.
We cover completely for that cold not to enter because when it enters you you will find you are sick.
Before plucking tea and you are attacked by malaria already you are sick.
Now when we want to pluck tea we wake up at five o'clock you prepare your tea.
You drink with your children they go to school as they go to school and you by six o'clock you are out you are carrying your two basket.
You go with them to the farm when you go with them to the farm.
You put the bigger one there and the smaller one you go with it to the farm.
And then we our custom is that we pray first and then we begin to pluck tea we pluck tea like this two leaves and one bud.
We begin to pluck tea and when you pluck tea.
You just pluck tea you pluck tea as you pluck tea and you throw in here.
As you pluck tea as you pluck tea as you throw in the small basket.
When you are in the company of your collegues you pluck even a song can pop up you sing.
Tell Jesus tell Jesus to be your friend you just sing as you pluck tea there is no other one than this one.
Oh tell Jesus tell Jesus to be your friend there is no other one than this one.
Tell Jesus himself you just sing a little and then you leave when it is full you carry you even carry from here.
Or one puts on the head and then we go you walk for some distance and then you go and pour on this one.
When you pour on this you return and come to pluck more and then we continue to pluck and we pluck we pluck for five hours.
When we pluck for five hours after we have finished plucking tea leaves we want to go now this one we will leave it.
We will leave this one now we shall carry tea leaves inside this one.
Then you load the other one is helping you to load it you really load you put it here you load and then you load your tea leaves now we are taking to the tea weighing centre.
A distance of like five kilometers.
And then we get to the tea weighing centre and then we offload our tea leaves we go and pour on the table that is there.
We pour there after pouring there we shall stay for like fifteen minutes the vehicle will come.
They will give us sacks we put in and then we weigh.
After weighing you will be given.
A receipt that is the kilos that you have weighed you are given you come with them from there with your basket you are going back home.
You go home it gets there you finish one month.
When you get into the new month like after six days.
Eeeh you go and get money from tea.
And then we go and then people go and get salary and then they reach there I want to sing.
